_readme: Copy to ~/.aria/answer_bank.json and fill in. Values like <...> count as unset, so Aria leaves those fields for you. Answers you give by voice or fix in review are added to 'learned' automatically.

answers.full_name: <full name as you want it on applications>
answers.sponsorship: <Yes / No — will you now or in the future require visa sponsorship>
answers.work_authorization: <Yes / No — are you authorized to work in the US>

eeo.veteran: <your answer, or: I don't wish to answer>
eeo.disability: <your answer, or: I don't wish to answer>
